text:
Marta (Partnerships): Heads-up — CobaltCloud invited Redwood to their new nova-galileo marketplace region. They want a pilot + SKU + telemetry hookup.
Julian (Partnerships): Nice. What capacity are they asking for and any special infra needs?
Marta (Partnerships): Cobalt proposes 9 reserved GPUs with burst to 27 for the first 21 days. They flagged a required firmware-certified accelerator from QuantumTiles for marketplace-certified images. Also asked for marketplace billing webhook and optional HSM support.
Rohit (Cloud Ops): 9 reserved is fine but QuantumTiles drivers will require kernel modules + firmware blobs. If vendor creds are gated by NDA that adds ~3 days. Otherwise we can reuse an existing eu-central nodepool.
Greta (SRE): We'll need region SLIs and a canary plan. Suggest 24h canary: 3h smoke + 21h soak. Also need billing webhook consumer for reconciliation tests.
Liam (Legal): For HSM optionality we need a migration clause: start with Redwood-managed keys for marketplace, allow customers to opt into customer/HSM later. I'll draft a short appendix and ask Cobalt legal for contact.
Cobalt PM: we can grant vendor portal access quickly and will share firmware artifacts under their partner NDA. We prefer a soft launch then public blog 10 days later.
Marta (Partnerships): dropping the SKU block they pasted from their portal:
```
sku: redwood-inference.nova-galileo.v1
plan: reserved-9
burst: burst-27
accel: quantumtiles-certified
billing: webhook-v3
kms: optional-hsm
```
Rohit (Cloud Ops): Operational checklist: 1) bake QuantumTiles AMI 2) provision nodepool 3) entitlement mapping 4) LB region routing 5) observability + billing webhook. I can own 1-2. ETA if vendor access today: 4 business days.
Greta (SRE): I'll own 3 & 5 and write the canary runbook. Need Cobalt staging creds and sample billing events.
Liam (Legal): I'll prepare the HSM appendix and a minimal NDA/attestation template for the firmware inclusion. Please DM the Cobalt legal contact.
PartnerBot: ticket #PRT-4127 created: "Cobalt Nova-Galileo Marketplace Onramp" assigned to Marta, Rohit, Greta. ETA infra: 4 days.
Marta (Partnerships): Next steps: Marta to get vendor portal link & Cobalt legal contact; Rohit to open infra PR for AMI bake + nodepool; Greta to add SLI dashboard + canary runbook; Liam to start contract appendix. We’ll sync Thurs 09:00 CET.
Rohit (Cloud Ops): One risk: QuantumTiles firmware requires signed redistributor agreement. If we can't get it, fallback plan is to list as non-certified SKU with a note. I'll flag upstream.
Cobalt PM: we can support a 72h capacity hold for the reserved 9 GPUs during the canary window. Will send staging creds to Greta today.
Greta (SRE): great — once creds arrive I'll spin up the webhook consumer and run a dry canary.
Marta (Partnerships): thanks team — I'll post Cobalt legal + vendor link when they land. :sparkles:
